summary.text: EGGUM REVISJON AS is a private limited company registered in Lillestrøm, founded 2005-04-01. EGGUM REVISJON AS provides audit and consulting services and all activities naturally connected to these. It was previously named EGGUM INVEST AS until 2019-10-24. Its main industry code is 69.201: auditing. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 1 773 065 NOK and the annual result was 135 401 NOK; operating income was up from 1 515 550 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 15 281 NOK in 2024 to 135 401 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 459 677 NOK in 2024 to 595 078 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Peter Daniel Lithell-Eggum (daglig leder and styrets leder). Its verified website is eggumrevisjon.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram profiles. The register's most recent update was on 2026-02-11 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
